candidates: When adding a tool-setup step (e.g., `pnpm/action-setup`) to a GitHub Actions workflow, include an inline comment or note in the PR description explaining why it is required. In this project, which uses pnpm (pnpm-lock.yaml is present), `npx` commands that auto-detect lock files will try to invoke pnpm and fail if it is not installed in the runner; make this dependency explicit so reviewers can assess whether the setup step is correct rather than incidental.
